task.description: WF-02 Step 2a: implement search/2 in lib/letflow/definitions.ex per lib/letflow/design/search.md (PASSed CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR). Verify branch feature/WF02-REQ042-20260817 first. No new migrations (design confirms this). REWORK ITERATION 1: REVIEWER (Step 2d) FAILed on one item -- the ranking CASE SQL literal is duplicated verbatim in select_with_rank/3 and order_by_rank/3. REVIEWER independently verified (read Ecto's builder.ex source + reproduced empirically via Mix.install) that fragment(^helper_fn(), ...) is rejected by Ecto's SQL-injection compile-time-literal guard, but fragment(@module_attribute, ...) compiles cleanly since a module attribute is inlined as a literal before Ecto's macro-expansion check runs. Fix: extract the CASE SQL text to a single @rank_case_sql module attribute defined once near the top of the search/2 section, reference it unchanged via fragment(@rank_case_sql, ...) at both call sites. Re-run mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted after the change.
acceptance_criteria: mix format --check-formatted exits 0 on the changed file
search/2 implemented exactly per the design's signature and error shapes ({:error, :query_empty}, {:error, :query_too_long}, {:ok, [search_result]})
Ranking: single fragment/1 CASE (exact name match 3.0, partial name ILIKE match 2.0, else 1.0), ORDER BY rank DESC, created_at DESC
SQL-injection safety: '%' wildcard composed into the bound ^pattern value in Elixir, never string-interpolated into fragment SQL text
Tenant-scoped via the same opts()/:prefix pattern as create/2, get_by_id/2, list/2 (prefix resolved via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1)
No new migration/table/index added -- moduledoc updated per the design's SS10 required text citing PD-10
Pagination: limit default 20, offset default 0, NOT clamped to a max (per design's explicit divergence from list/2's clamp-to-200)
self-review checklist per WF-02 Step 2a: no SQL string interpolation, no unresolved {:ok,_} = match on external I/O, new public function has @doc

result.summary: Implemented Letflow.Definitions.search/2 in lib/letflow/definitions.ex exactly per lib/letflow/design/search.md: search_opts()/search_result()/search_error() types added; validation order is check_query_not_empty/1 (byte_size==0 -> {:error, :query_empty}) then check_query_not_too_long/1 (byte_size>512 -> {:error, :query_too_long}) then TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 on opts[:prefix] -> {:error, :invalid_schema_name} on failure, all before any Repo call. WHERE clause: where_search_match/2 builds fragment("? ILIKE ? OR ? ILIKE ?", d.name, ^pattern, d.description, ^pattern) with pattern = "%" <> query <> "%" computed once in Elixir and pinned (^pattern) -- never spliced into the fragment's SQL text. Ranking: select_with_rank/3 and order_by_rank/3 both use the identical fragment("CASE WHEN lower(?) = lower(?) THEN 3.0 WHEN ? ILIKE ? THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END", d.name, ^query, d.name, ^pattern) CASE expression (3.0 exact name / 2.0 partial name / 2.0->else 1.0 description-only), ORDER BY rank DESC, created_at DESC. Pagination: effective_limit = Keyword.get(opts,:limit) || 20, effective_offset = Keyword.get(opts,:offset) || 0, applied via limit/2+offset/2 with NO clamp (deliberate divergence from list/2's effective_limit/1 clamp-to-200, per design SS7). No-match falls through naturally to {:ok, Repo.all(ecto_query, prefix: prefix)} returning []. No new migration/table/index. Moduledoc gained the required SS10 paragraph (module moduledoc + Scope section) citing PD-10 and definition.md explicitly. Note: attempted to share the CASE SQL string via a `rank_case_sql/0` helper pinned into fragment/1 (`fragment(^rank_case_sql(), ...)`) -- Ecto raised Ecto.Query.CompileError ('to prevent SQL injection attacks, fragment(...) does not allow strings to be interpolated as the first argument via the ^ operator') at compile time, so the literal CASE string is duplicated verbatim in select_with_rank/3 and order_by_rank/3 instead (both are fixed compile-time string literals, not a security issue, just a minor duplication) -- flagging for REVIEWER in case a cleaner shared-literal approach (e.g. a module attribute) is preferred. Verification commands run directly (mix and elixir present locally, no Docker fallback needed): `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> 'Compiling 1 file (.ex)' / 'Generated letflow app', exit 0. `mix format --check-formatted lib/letflow/definitions.ex` -> no output, exit 0. Self-review: grep confirms every fragment/1 call's SQL-text argument is a fixed string literal (no interpolation/concatenation into fragment text); no bare {:ok, _} = match added; search/2 has a @doc.
issues: Minor: the rank CASE SQL literal is duplicated (once in select_with_rank/3, once in order_by_rank/3) rather than shared via a helper, because Ecto's fragment/1 rejects a pinned/dynamic first argument (Ecto.Query.CompileError, SQL-injection guard) -- not a defect, just noted for REVIEWER.
